label: The arctangent form
subgoals: An integrand of the form one over a squared plus x squared produces an arctangent.
The coefficient is one over a.

label: Completing the square
subgoals: Rewrite the quadratic as a shift squared plus a constant.
Substitute to reach the standard arctangent form.

label: Choosing the substitution
subgoals: Match the integrand to the arcsine or arctangent pattern.
A square root of a squared minus x squared points to arcsine.
